fact: You can write the NCA exams online, from home in India, and they are offered every month.
The fastest path to the NCA Certificate of Qualification is about 10 months. The average candidate takes about two years.
Since 1 March 2026 every NCA applicant gets English screening and an Indigenous law course.
The NCA Certificate of Qualification is not a licence to practise. A province's law society licenses lawyers.
Canada outside Quebec uses common law, like India, so the way of reasoning in the exams will feel familiar.
Most applicants are assigned a handful of core exams: constitutional law, administrative law, criminal law, professional responsibility and foundations of Canadian law.
